CREATE: the to-units are new units, active in the draft.
RETIRE: the from-units were active in the base version and are retired in the draft.
RENAME: one unit, same code, whose name differs from the base version.
RECODE: one old code (retired) to one new code (new), on the same level.
SPLIT: one from-unit (retired, or kept as one of the parts) to two or more active to-units.
MERGE: two or more from-units (retired, or the survivor) to one active to-unit.
REPARENT: one unit, same code, whose parent differs from the base version.
BOUNDARY_CHANGE: units active in both versions whose boundary changed.
